title: 掷骰子
problem_statement_md:
在玩棋盘游戏时，你和你的朋友掷骰子，掷出较大数字的人向前移动。

请写一个函数`max`，将两个数字作为参数，并返回两个数字中较大的值，打印结果。
如果数字相等，函数必须返回该数字。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Functions with multiple parameters[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

While playing a board game, you and your friend roll the dice and the person who rolled the higher number moves forward.
Write a function that takes two numbers as arguments and returns the higher number of the two. Print the result.
If numbers are equal function must return that number.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
1
6

[b]Sample Output[/b]
6

[note]Remember to call the function and then print the returned result.  [/note]
hint_md: 记住要调用函数，然后打印返回的结果。
